Westham Island is a Fraser River estuary farm island off Ladner whose land base is farmland (more than 700 hectares) under the Agricultural Land Reserve, and ALR residences cannot be stratified. The island's housing is therefore farmhouses and acreages, plus float homes at the Westham Island Marina that are moorage-tenure product, not strata condos.

items.t: Identity: Westham Island is a real island in the Fraser River estuary off Ladner, City of Delta — Environment and Climate Change Canada places the island's Alaksen National Wildlife Area just under 10 km west of Ladner in the Municipality of Delta, reached by crossing the bridge to Westham Island and following Westham Island Road, and the Province states the Westham Island Bridge is the island's only road access point.
The page's "For sale" quick link points to the Ladner homes for sale page, not to a Westham Island feed page.

Nearby areas: Ladner across Canoe Pass to the east; Tsawwassen to the south; Steveston (Richmond) across the Fraser River's south arm to the north. Port Guichon — named here only to fix its geography — is in Ladner, not Tsawwassen and not on Westham Island.
Where condo stock concentrates: nowhere on the island.

items.t: No stratification in the ALR (standing rule): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)). ALC residence caps on ALR land: a principal residence is limited to 500 m² or less total floor area, with no more than 1,000 m² of fill placed for its construction; a secondary suite is permitted only within the principal residence; and one additional residence may be permitted at up to 90 m² total floor area on properties of 40 ha or less, or up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha, with local government rules also applying.

BC Assessment farm class (standing figures): farm-class thresholds are $2,500 of farm income for land of 0.8–4 ha, $2,500 plus 5% of the value of land over 4 ha, and $10,000 for land under 0.8 ha, with applications by October 31 — the class test a small island acreage purchase has to plan around; verify the current-year figures with BC Assessment for a specific property before relying on them.
Delta zoning — number contested, flagged, not settled: The one island zoning fact on an official sample is parcel-level: 2194 Westham Island Road is zoned Agriculture (A 1).

items.t: Westham Island is a real island in the Fraser River estuary off Ladner, City of Delta — Environment and Climate Change Canada places its Alaksen National Wildlife Area just under 10 km west of Ladner, reached by crossing the bridge and following Westham Island Road. The Province states the Westham Island Bridge is the island's only road access point. Nearby: Ladner across Canoe Pass to the east; Tsawwassen to the south; Steveston (Richmond) across the Fraser's south arm to the north.
The guide names Delta Secondary only. Catchments: no SD37 locator run for an island address is on record.

The bridge (TransLink): the Westham Island Bridge officially opened March 29, 1910; it is the oldest of the five bridges TransLink owns and operates, operated by TransLink since 1999, its narrowest bridge, a partial single-lane swing bridge over Canoe Pass (swing span opens roughly seven or eight times a day, mainly for fishing boats), with a load limit of 50 tons.

The 2026 strike, closure and reopening — both bases stated: the bridge was struck by a marine vessel on January 20, 2026 and closed to vehicles (significant damage to a primary support structure; emergency barge service funded during repairs).

Flood protection: the island sits behind dikes; the City of Delta is the diking authority and operates over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure.
How people search for it: "Westham Island," "Westham Island Delta," "Westham Island farms," "Westham Island homes for sale," "Reifel Bird Sanctuary."

items.t: OCP — Delta: the consolidated Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), adopted July 8, 2024, applies — a single consolidated plan; its designation list (s.1.5.1) does not include "Single Family Residential," and farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)."
Zoning — Delta: the zoning bylaw number is contested (7600, 2017 vs "8400, 2025"). The one official sample parcel is zoned Agriculture (A 1).

SSMUH — Delta: Bylaws 8394 + 8395 (June 24, 2024); Delta's SSMUH zoning allows up to 4 units on single-detached and duplex lots, with City support for accessory dwelling units such as coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites — on ALR land the ALC rules below govern first, and Delta's page does not override them.

ALR block (island farm ground): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). Caps: principal ≤500 m² total floor area (no more than 1,000 m² of fill for its construction), suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha), with local government rules also applying. Farm class three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

Alaksen is four islands joined by dykes: Alaksen National Wildlife Area, 349 ha on Westham Island, was established in 1976 and mainly consists of four former deltaic islands joined by causeways and dykes; it is part of the Fraser River Delta Ramsar Site and of the Boundary Bay – Roberts Bank – Sturgeon Bank Important Bird Area, is managed by the Canadian Wildlife Service, and is open 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., Monday to Friday excluding statutory holidays. A section of Alaksen overlaps with the George C. Reifel Migratory Bird Sanctuary; both areas are reached through their front gates on Robertson Road (NWA gate 5421 Robertson Rd; sanctuary gate 5191 Robertson Rd).

blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in Westham Island
What a duplex looks like in Westham Island

items.t: The usual duplex form: Delta's SSMUH zoning allows up to 4 units on single-detached and duplex lots, with City support for accessory dwelling units such as coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites — but on ALR land the ALC residence rules govern first, and Delta's page does not override them. The island's documented land base is farmland — more than 700 hectares producing seed potatoes (more than 25% of B.C.'s seed potatoes), vegetables, berries, forage and pasture, plus fruit, honey and livestock — and the one official City sample property (2194 Westham Island Road, Reynelda Farms Ltd.) is zoned Agriculture (A 1) and entirely within the ALR, a 65.2 ha site. Any duplex-form building on the island would be an individual building on a single parcel under that frame. Farm-residence forms are stated only as the ALR sources support.
